description.zh: Addon名称，当 AddonName 赋值时，将忽略 ReleaseName 参数批量卸载所属于同一个 Addon 的所有 AddonRelease。
description.en: The name of the add-on. If you assign a value to AddonName, the ReleaseName parameter is ignored and all AddonReleases that belong to the same add-on are deleted.
Whether to be forcibly deleted. The default value is false.

example.unifiedCli: aliyun arms delete-addon-release --release-name agent-822567d4-2449 --biz-force false --biz-region-id cn-hangzhou --environment-id env-xxx --addon-name mysql --api-version 2019-08-08 --region cn-hangzhou
example.legacyCli: aliyun arms DeleteAddonRelease --region cn-hangzhou --EnvironmentId 'env-xxx' --Force false --AddonName mysql --RegionId 'cn-hangzhou' --ReleaseName 'agent-822567d4-2449'
